raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the genealogy after confirming Archduke Leopold Salvator’s parents. It incorrectly advanced one generation and named Karl Salvator’s mother, Princess Maria Antonia of the Two Sicilies, as Dolores’s paternal grandmother—confusing a paternal grandmother with a paternal great-grandmother. The correct paternal grandmother is Leopold Salvator’s mother, Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies, as stated on the source page.
